mapper.insert: INSERT INTO indicators (project_code, topic, name, code, business_definition, calc_expr, default_filter, alert_config, business_owner, tech_owner, refresh_interval, refresh_unit, refresh_desc, visibility) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{topic}, #{name}, #{code}, #{businessDefinition}, #{calcExpr}, #{defaultFilter}, #{alertConfig}, #{businessOwner}, #{techOwner}, #{refreshInterval}, #{refreshUnit}, #{refreshDesc}, #{visibility}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET project_code = EXCLUDED.project_code, topic = EXCLUDED.topic, name = EXCLUDED.name, business_definition = EXCLUDED.business_definition, calc_expr = EXCLUDED.calc_expr, default_filter = EXCLUDED.default_filter, alert_config = EXCLUDED.alert_config, business_owner = EXCLUDED.business_owner, tech_owner = EXCLUDED.tech_owner, refresh_interval = EXCLUDED.refresh_interval, refresh_unit = EXCLUDED.refresh_unit, refresh_desc = EXCLUDED.refresh_desc, visibility = EXCLUDED.visibility, updated_at = NOW()
